reviews_verbatim.author: Jorie Lynn
reviews_verbatim.text: This company did absolutely beautiful work and such a short amount of time! They were able to do five rooms of tile which included carpet removal within three days so we could move into our new home. They were extremely knowledgeable and helpful and the floors turned out beautiful.

reviews_verbatim.author: Faith Akinduro
reviews_verbatim.text: Nunes 4Flooring Co. recently updated the downstairs of our home from carpet to hardwood, and our fireplace and we have not stopped raving about their incredible service to our friends and neighbors. When they arrived for the initial walkthrough, they came on time and was completely respectful of our space. We were told the work would take three days, however they finished it all in just ONE DAY.

reviews_verbatim.author: Sarah
reviews_verbatim.text: They were hired to replace some of a stairwell, matching the stain color to the existing wood. The came on time, with the right materials and did this perfectly. I had three other floors that needed to be done as well as bathroom tiling, including an unexpected hole in the shower wall from the plumbers. They fit me in and had EVERYTHING done in about 24 hours!!! Everyone was so impressed by their work.

reviews_verbatim.author: Guadalupe Gonzalez
reviews_verbatim.text: We recently had Nunes 4 Flooring Corp come out to replace all of our carpet and laminate with LVP. They brought us some samples and walked us through all the options and pricing. We quoted several flooring places and found Nunes 4 Flooring Corp to be the best by far in price, clarity of quote and quality of flooring. These guys don't subcontract out the work which is what all the other companies we called do.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jim Waters
reviews_verbatim.text: Nunes 4 Flooring is hands down the leader in integrity, transparency, craftsmanship and customer service. They laid high quality LVP throughput our home. The process was seamless from the day they came to our home for the free estimate to the last day of the project. They are quick to respond to questions, very knowledgeable and extremely efficent.

reviews_verbatim.author: Sharon T
reviews_verbatim.text: I cannot say enough good things about Nunes 4flooring. Emmanuel and Bernardo took my kitchen from drab to fab. They came when they said they would be here. Always polite and respectful in my home. I didn't think that new baseboards would make such a difference but they were so right it looks fantastic.

reviews_verbatim.author: Debbie Norman
reviews_verbatim.text: Beautiful job installing travertine tile in our pool area. They were all very conscientious with excellent skills and communication.
